analysis.reasonEn: 4 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI at 38.9 entering oversold territory, ADX at 28.8 shows a clear trend but -DI (30.5) is above +DI (21.0) indicating downside pressure. 5-day low of 68,895 is higher than 20-day low of 61,145, suggesting potential recovery, but price is capped by resistance around SMA5 (75,464) and SMA20 (78,671). With ATR at 7,741, a 1.3x ATR stop loss (10,063) allows for a target of 95,447 to achieve a 1.5 risk-reward ratio.
